recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. Further maintenance of the apheresis platelet and red cell antigen examples should occur in HL7/oo-incubator alongside the MedicalProductOfHumanOrigin profile, including any future URI, slicing, or example-detail refinements.
issue_request: FHIR-49665 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and requested two BiologicallyDerivedProduct examples conforming to the Medical Product of Human Origin profile: an apheresis platelet product with ISBT 128 product code E3046 and a red cell antigen red blood cell product with product code E0398.
initial_application: Core commits 8b315006f80ec885fd8093ef732a70889ab99e89 and 16d36096dbf0c4d53dbaf1c18e34a82ff66438ce added the two XML examples and registered them in source/biologicallyderivedproduct/list-BiologicallyDerivedProduct-examples.xml. A later unrelated FHIR-49655 commit touched the red-cell example/profile source, but the seed application itself was present before the MPHO migration.
additional_context: FHIR-52021 and FHIR-54998 later resolved that the MPHO profile should be removed from FHIR core and moved to the OO Incubator IG. Commit 6bf92471f8ac024d9dcfc067a2aab9f70a9416d9 deleted the MPHO profile and the two FHIR-49665 example files from core, and the current BiologicallyDerivedProduct introduction says the MPHO profile moved to OO Incubator. The HL7/oo-incubator repository now contains the MedicalProductOfHumanOrigin profile and both examples as FSH artifacts.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source was changed because the absence of these examples from the active core example list is the intended result of the later MPHO profile migration.

related_jiras.note: Resolved to remove the MPHO profile from core and move it to an OO Additional Resources/Incubator IG, directly affecting examples that claimed that profile.

evidence_items.learned: The current absence of these two examples from core is an intentional migration, not a missing application of FHIR-49665.

evidence_items.summary: The active BiologicallyDerivedProduct introduction says the MPHO profile moved to the OO Incubator IG, and the current examples list contains only the general, allogeneic HCT, and autologous HCT examples.
evidence_items.learned: Current core source intentionally points MPHO work outside core and no longer registers the two profile-based examples.

evidence_items.learned: The profile and both FHIR-49665 examples now have an external IG maintenance home, so the core reconciliation should be an external-repo audit.
